title: Header UX/UI Refactor - Smart Sticky, Search Hotkey & Mobile Drawer Polish
goals: Enable Smart Sticky header mode (auto-hide on scroll down, auto-reveal on scroll up) for maximal reading focus.
Add keyboard shortcut (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K / slash) support with clean visual hint for search.
Improve Mobile Drawer UX with body scroll-lock and polished touch targets.
Refine navbar active indicator and micro-interactions.
